data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Northern Hexes Churn While Stonecradle and Farranac Coast Erupt
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the previous edition, intense fighting has spread westward, with Stonecradle and Farranac Coast erupting into rapid base exchanges and surging casualties. In Stonecradle, three base transitions occurred over the last two hours around The Cord and Trammel Pool amid over twelve hundred casualties, while Farranac Coast recorded the capture of Transient Valley amidst a sudden casualty spike exceeding thirteen hundred. The northern theater remains in relentless turmoil: Stlican Shelf registered ten base transitions in the past two hours alone, while Weathered Expanse sustained over twenty-eight hundred combined casualties in the same span across hotly contested positions like Wightwalk and Shattered Advance. Viper Pit also flared back to life with three base events at Blackthroat. Though base lines have temporarily stabilized in Callahan's Passage, combat there continues at a blistering pace with more than twenty-five hundred casualties in two hours. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy persists in attritional deadlock, and rear territories remain completely dormant.
